description: This file defines a class 'ModelResponseIterator' that handles streaming responses from a language model, parsing chunks of data, managing both synchronous and asynchronous iteration, and extracting relevant information such as text content, tool calls, usage, and finish reasons.

classes.name: ModelResponseIterator
classes.description: A class for iterating over streaming responses from a language model, supporting both sync and async modes, and parsing chunks into structured data.

methods.name: chunk_parser
methods.description: Parses a JSON chunk into a GenericStreamingChunk object, extracting text, tool calls, usage, and finish status.

methods.name: __next__
methods.description: Retrieves the next chunk from the synchronous response stream, handling JSON parsing and errors.

methods.name: __anext__
methods.description: Retrieves the next chunk from the async response stream, handling JSON parsing, '[DONE]' signals, and errors.
